Messages.Author: Otto Koskinen
Messages.Body:
Name: The Slow Withering
[Gehenna:R]
Cardtype: Event
Gehenna. Do not replace until a vampire commits diablerie.
Requires at least one other Gehenna card in play. Cards that require
any superior Disciplines cost an additional blood to play. Any vampire
who commits diablerie is immune to this effect until the next Gehenna
card is played.

"Cards that require any superior Disciplines cost an additional blood
to play."

How is this to be understood?
a) Cards played at superior?
b) Cards like Elemental Stoicism which requires a superior and
inferior? (FOR obf)
c) Cards that have the option to be played at superior? Ie. Deflection
played by Marciana Giovanni.

Funny, but this actually *DID* come up.

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:

cards played at the superior version. =)

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:


a) and b), but not c). Any card that is played at a level that requires
one or more superior effects. So, eg, playing Elemental Stoicism at the
[for] or [for obf] levels doesn't count, but playing it at the [FOR obf]
level does.

--Colin McGuigan
